verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is possible, but only indirectly through external AI agents. The Fin CLI is built for AI coding agents to set up Fin and configure the Intercom helpdesk (docs-38). The official MCP server lets AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude access and act on Intercom data (docs-5, probe-4, intdir-5). Missing for 10: a documented native natural-language command interface for operating or configuring Fin itself, detail on which admin operations the CLI or MCP actually expose, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
